upcoming.label: Saturday, September 5
upcoming.title: Mass, Mini-Golf, and Ice Cream
upcoming.description: Join us for the 4:30pm Vigil Mass at St. Bridget, then pizza at Newman afterwards. After eating, we'll head to Big Swings Golf Center for Mini Golf! Cost is $7 for students.

upcoming.label: Wednesday, September 9
upcoming.title: Mass of the Holy Spirit
upcoming.description: Join us for a Mass of the Holy Spirit and mark the start of a new semester! Pizza and Mr. Softee will follow afterwards outside on the parish porch.

upcoming.label: Saturday, September 12
upcoming.title: St. Anthony's Procession
upcoming.location: St. Anthony's Society (Next to St. Bridget)
upcoming.description: Represent Rowan Catholic in the St. Anthony Procession!

upcoming.label: Monday, September 14
upcoming.title: Summit Place Bible Study
upcoming.description: Service Oppurtunity to lead a Bible Study for the residents of a local nursing home. Meet at Newman at 10:45am and we will be back by 12:15pm.

upcoming.label: Wednesday, September 16
upcoming.title: Weekly Newman Night Dinner and Talk
upcoming.description: Join us for a free meal at 6pm followed by our 'Open House' meeting where all of our ministries get to showcase what they do.

upcoming.label: Sunday, September 20
upcoming.title: Coffee and Donuts
upcoming.description: Join us at St. Bridget after the 9am Mass or before the 11am Mass out on the parish porch for coffee, donuts, and fellowship. For those attending before the 11am, please be sure to finish eating by 10:30am to uphold your 1 hour Communion fast.

upcoming.label: Wednesday, September 23
upcoming.title: Weekly Newman Night Dinner and Talk
upcoming.description: Join us for a free meal at 6pm followed by the first part of a series by Fr. Piro, 'Back to the Basics of the Catholic Faith.' This part is titled 'What Do You Believe?'

upcoming.label: Wednesday, September 30
upcoming.title: 40 Hours Devotion Opening Mass
upcoming.description: This 9am Mass will open our 40 Hours Devotion with a special Healing Mass for anyone in need of mental, physical, or spiritual healing. The Sacrament of Anointing of the Sick will be provided.
